title: Bundesliga 2025/26: fewest conceded
brief: Name the ten clubs that conceded the fewest Bundesliga goals in 2025/26.

notes.Union Berlin: Union Berlin conceded 58, just outside in 11th.
notes.Werder Bremen: Werder Bremen conceded 60, joint 12th with St Pauli.
notes.St Pauli: St Pauli conceded 60, joint 12th with Werder Bremen.

checks: Goals against in Wikipedia's final table match the table worked out from every 2025/26 result at football-data.co.uk, and Transfermarkt's table. Ties inside the ten (RB Leipzig and Leverkusen on 47, Mainz and Gladbach on 53) are listed in league position order; Freiburg (57) are 10th outright.
